name: Connectionist Bench Sonar Benchmark (Mines vs. Rocks)
description: The Connectionist Bench (Sonar, Mines vs. Rocks) dataset consists of 208 sonar signal returns gathered by bouncing wideband sonar signals off metal cylinders and rocks at varying aspect angles. Each pattern comprises 60 continuous numerical energy readings in frequency bands to train neural networks to discriminate mines from rocks.
